title: SocialPlayerProfiles
description: Create social profiles and view others'
body:
If you want your players to create profiles, this one is for you.

How it Works?
- Players have a gui (called page) and they add their informations (mostly their social media accounts such as Youtube,Steam and Reddit) to this page.
- At default, just their username is added and the number of kills and deaths after plugin is installed.
- Informations that can be added are stated at gallery. 
- This page also include kills and deaths.
- And people can socialize

HOW TO USE
- Drop .jar file into plugins directory.

Features
- If a player joins the server and has no profile, a profile will be created for that player.

Commands
- /profile view <playername>: view a player's profile (To see your own profile, write your username
- /profile edit <Platform> <Value>: Edit your profile
- /profile help: help command

Permissions
- playerprofiles.view: Perm for view command
